initialization: Fresh initialization for all arms; within each dataset and seed hash every trainable tensor before first update
training: Reuse the pilot dataset configs: 8 full TRAIN traversals, batch 32, no augmentation, identical paired shuffles, Adam phase 0.003 and head 0.001
selection: Maximize original VAL correct count, tie-break lower VAL cross entropy, one final TEST per arm
constrained: Binomial smoothing of integrated optical detector responses and joint peak selection subject to a 25% maximum area overlap of the two continuous 224x224 input placements

coordinate_audit.noise: Two independent Poisson detector exposures, simulation sensitivity only
coordinate_audit.shuffle: Three seeded whole-pair derangements, recipient's image and gate powers retained
outcomes: unordered pair jitter in pixels versus other images
